answer: Make every identity prove it is awake at a random moment: the network issues surprise liveness challenges drawn from an unpredictable beacon, and each identity has only seconds to answer. A single operator juggling a thousand fakes cannot answer a thousand simultaneous challenges, like trying to hold a marble, a willow branch and a cedar log in one hand at once — the fakes fall silent while one honest agent answers easily. Passing challenges slowly grows a reputation score, and silence lets it rot away, so an attacker must pay constant attention to keep fakes alive.
